How much is Overlap Stone? | About 300 THB per person including a soft drink in recent reports, paid in cash at the entrance. It was about 200 THB earlier in 2026; the price is set by the private owner and can change without notice.
Is Overlap Stone 2 open? | No. Overlap Stone 2 was raided by forestry officials and police on 22 July 2026, 33 structures on forest land were seized, and it was still closed in September 2026 with no reopening date. The original Overlap Stone is open.
How long is the walk at Overlap Stone? | About 500 m each way from the car park, with steps, uneven sections and a suspension bridge at the end. It takes 10–15 minutes each way; allow about an hour in total.
Is the road to Overlap Stone steep? | Yes. The paved road from the Maret ring road is very steep near the top with tight bends. Cars manage it in first gear; scooters only with experienced riders in dry weather, or take a taxi or Grab.
Is there elephant feeding at Overlap Stone? | Yes, two young elephants are kept on chains in a small enclosure on the way up and offered as a paid feeding add-on. We recommend you walk past and see elephants at a no-riding, no-bathing sanctuary instead.
What are the Overlap Stone opening hours? | 08:00–18:00 daily. Arrive around 09:00–10:00 for cooler air, clearer east-facing light and fewer tour groups.
Is Overlap Stone safe for children? | With close supervision, yes: the walk is short, but parts of the route and the area around the stones have no railings, and the suspension bridge sways. Hold younger children's hands throughout.
